thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool 'saturn-prod-usw2' reporting GPU saturation for tenant Saturn. Pool utilization 100%, queue depth spiking. Auto-scaling failed after 3 attempts. Paging on-call.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alice Chen (on-call) — you have been paged for incident 1779998888. Priority P1.

alice.chen: Ack — looking. Any customer impact already reported?

saturn_ops: Saturn ops here — yes, we're seeing generation requests fail with 429s and timeouts, started ~5m ago. High priority customer-facing app degraded. Links: https://saturn.example.com/alerts

bob.martinez: I'm with infra-sre, standing by to help with pool actions. Is this Dedicated (reserved) or burstable for Saturn?

carmen.li: Confirmed dedicated pool 'saturn-prod-usw2' is at 100% GPU allocation. Autoscaler attempted add but failed due to quota in region. Error in controller logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:12:01Z autoscaler: launch_instance failed: quotaExceeded: 'GPU quota' for project
Attempt 1..3
```

fiona.kim: Runtime signals high KV-cache thrashing and many small seq requests. Could reduce concurrency per-session as mitigation.

alice.chen: Immediate mitigation plan proposals:
- temporarily enable manual burst (grant extra GPU capacity from spare-pool) for 60m
- throttle low-priority tenant tasks (batch jobs) to free slots
- apply 503 fallback to non-critical routes and roll to lighter model variant for latency-sensitive traffic
- notify Saturn account team and coordinate maintenance window

danielle.s: I'm AE for Saturn, open channel with them. If we can enable burst now they will accept a 1-hour window while they spin up internal fallbacks.

ev an_cs: CS on standby for customer comms. Recommend short message to customer: "We're seeing degraded inference performance; our team is enabling emergency capacity to restore service. We'll update in 15m."

alice.chen: Running commands to enable manual burst (requires infra privilege). Carmen, Bob — can you approve and run?

carmen.li: Approving. Running spike-override now:
```
./infra-tools override-burst --pool saturn-prod-usw2 --add 4gpus --duration 60m --reason "manual emergency burst for Saturn"
```

bob.martinez: Command executed. API response: {
  "status": "queued",
  "task_id": "override-8899"
}

incident-bot: Manual burst override queued; allocating from spare-pool. Expected provisioning ~120s.

saturn_ops: We see some successful requests coming through, latency dropping. Still intermittent 5xxs.

fiona.kim: Pushing runtime fallback: scale down model to 'vicuna-13b-8bit' for non-critical endpoints, keep high-quality model for VIP routes. Applying canary now.

alice.chen: Canary applied to 10% of traffic. Monitoring.

carmen.li: Spare-pool allocation succeeded. GPUs attached and running. Pool utilization now 92%.

saturn_ops: Error rate has dropped ~70%. Thank you.

alice.chen: Next actions: continue monitoring. If autoscaler quota is the root cause, we need quota request for region and post-incident follow-up. Also schedule capacity planning call with Saturn.

danielle.s: I'll coordinate the capacity planning meeting. Recommend raising region quota now so autoscaler can self-heal later.

bob.martinez: Filing a support ticket with cloud provider to increase GPU quota. Ticket ID CSP-90321.

alice.chen: Paging update — handing off to second on-call @carmen.li for next 45m while I draft the incident bridge notes and customer message. Carmen, take ownership.

carmen.li: Taking on-call. I will monitor pool and confirm degradation resolved. If errors reappear, escalate to platform-eng.

ev an_cs: Message to customer queued:
"We detected GPU capacity exhaustion in your dedicated pool. We've enabled emergency capacity to restore service and are working on a long-term fix. We'll follow up within 60 minutes with next steps."

saturn_ops: Acknowledged. Appreciate the quick response.

alice.chen: Post-incident tasks (assigned):
- autoscaler: investigate quota handling and improve retries (fiona.kim)
- runbook: update manual-burst checklist and approval matrix (carmen.li)
- customer follow-up: schedule capacity planning (danielle.s)
- RCA + postmortem: include timeline and cost impact (alice.chen)

fiona.kim: Quick note: add a metric alert for 'autoscaler_quota_failures' to avoid silent failures.

incident-bot: Incident 1779998888 status: Mitigated -> manual burst applied, error rate reduced. Next update in 15m or on next significant change.

carmen.li: Monitoring steady. Handing to on-call rotation: @bob.martinez for overnight check-in in case of regression.

bob.martinez: I'll check logs hourly and confirm cloud ticket progress.

saturn_ops: We'll remain on standby. Thanks everyone.

alice.chen: Closing active paging. Will create postmortem doc link and ping channel when ready.

incident-bot: Incident 1779998888 closed for active paging at 2026-03-15T22:09:59Z; postmortem pending.
